description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing Self Beneficiaries for Third Party Transfers (TPT) within a financial application. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, adding, updating, deleting, and listing beneficiaries linked to the current user. The class is annotated with JAX-RS and Swagger annotations for API documentation, and it interacts with underlying services to perform its operations.

classes.name: SelfBeneficiariesTPTApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints for managing Self Beneficiaries for Third Party Transfers in a financial application.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Returns a template with account type options for creating a new beneficiary.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a new third-party transfer beneficiary linked to the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing beneficiary specified by beneficiaryId.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an existing beneficiary specified by beneficiaryId.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all beneficiaries linked to the current user.
